scope_description: NFL Week 8, 2026 Regular Season — Sunday only

selected_games_scope.description: All scheduled Sunday Week 8 games only; exclude Thursday October 29 and Monday November 2 games
selected_games_scope.schedule_source: NFL.com 2026 schedule; CBS Sports Week 8 schedule cross-check

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games

distribution_statistic_override.sample_definition: Use the 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before the historical cutoff, separate from L10
distribution_statistic_override.qualification_use: Not a Stage 1 qualification requirement; do not use sportsbook pricing to calculate 7P

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 7
historical_cutoff.note: Stage 1 must verify that this game completed and use only qualifying games completed before its actual completion.

current_sportsbook_source.fallback: DraftKings only if FanDuel data is unavailable for the required market
